cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the WordPress Site Administrator position. Your emphasis on analysis, delivery, and continuous improvement resonates with my approach to digital marketing and web development. With a unique blend of technical expertise and strategic thinking, I am confident I can contribute to your team from day one.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic. I also build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, handling content uploads and page updates. This hands-on experience has given me a deep understanding of WordPress site administration, including performance tracking and optimization.

My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to go beyond the basics. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's search-health score. This project showcases my commitment to data-driven growth and continuous improvement.

I am particularly drawn to your key strengths in e-commerce expertise, technical development, and data-driven growth. My experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, combined with my front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript), positions me well to optimize WordPress sites for performance, user experience, and conversion rates.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am eager to bring my skills to your team and help drive measurable results. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
